declared_purpose: Provide local conversational memory for OpenClaw: explicitly requested verbatim remembering, semantic recall with reinforcement, archival forgetting, status, and native-flush-driven learning. The entry declares plaintext local storage and no cloud synchronization (SKILL.md:20-37,43-85,102-106). Full-message caching, keyword extraction, payload details, and retention cutoffs are implementation choices described below.

data_operations.operation: Read local runtime configuration and discover Python
data_operations.source: Package configuration, environment, home directory, and executable paths
data_operations.data_scope: config.yaml; CONDA_PREFIX, CONDA, home-directory paths, PATH executable locations
data_operations.condition: Core configuration loads at import; wrapper and daemon discover Python before launching their respective scripts.

data_operations.operation: Forward inputs to a local child process and return its output
data_operations.data_scope: Remembered content, recall query, forget content, or supplied conversation; child stdout
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: fluid_skill.py through subprocess arguments; stdout returned to the wrapper's caller
data_operations.condition: The corresponding wrapper action and argument are supplied. No remote recipient or persistent process log is established.

data_operations.data_scope: fluid_memory collection and its persistent records
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local CHROMA_PATH, constructed from ~/.openclaw/workspace and database\chroma_store
data_operations.condition: Chroma imports and initialization succeeds. The legacy core branch explicitly disables anonymized telemetry; modern core and maintenance initialization omit that setting. Dependency-side behavior remains unknown.

data_operations.operation: Persist supplied memory text and access metadata
data_operations.source: remember(content), including calls from summarization functions
data_operations.data_scope: Complete content, timestamp-derived identifier, created_at, last_accessed, access_count, and active status
data_operations.condition: Vector mode is available and collection.add succeeds. Explicit remembering is documented as preserving the user's original words.

data_operations.operation: Append complete event content to a plaintext conversation cache
data_operations.data_scope: Full event content and an ISO timestamp, labeled 用户说 without checking authorship
data_operations.condition: The installed hook receives type message, action sent, and nonempty content. No auto_learn configuration check, rotation, consumption, or deletion appears in the handler.

data_operations.operation: Infer categories through keyword matching, store selected segments, and return them
data_operations.data_scope: Entire pipe-separated segments assigned to preferences, decisions, todos, or learning; deduplicated to at most five segments per category
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Categorized JSON text submitted to remember; extracted categories returned to the caller
data_operations.condition: summarize is invoked. These are heuristic classifications, not verified user attributes. The implementation does not call an LLM API.

data_operations.operation: Read and construct an incremental summary; subsequent persistence is unresolved
data_operations.data_scope: Previous summary, round count, and entire segments containing 喜欢, 讨厌, 决定, 想, 要, or NSFW
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process memory; intended writes to database\summary_buffer.json or Chroma
data_operations.condition: increment_summarize reads and combines input, then references undefined SUMMARY_THRESHOLD. As packaged, it stops before writing. If that variable is supplied externally, it either saves the accumulated buffer or calls remember and resets the buffer. The reset does not check whether remembering succeeded.

data_operations.operation: Conditionally capture a query, retrieve memories, and reinforce returned records
data_operations.data_scope: Query; up to ten candidate documents and metadata; up to three returned texts and scores; updated access counts and timestamps
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Chroma query interface and persistent metadata; selected results returned to the caller
data_operations.condition: With vector mode available, packaged execution first fails on undefined AUTO_LEARN. If supplied externally, true additionally persists the query as conversation text; retrieval then filters by score above 0.05 and reinforces selected results. Decay uses created_at, not last_accessed.

data_operations.operation: Find one matching memory and soft-archive it
data_operations.source: Forget keyword and active Chroma records
data_operations.data_scope: Nearest matching document, identifier, and metadata; status changed to archive
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Existing Chroma record; matching text returned to the caller for confirmation
data_operations.condition: Vector mode exists and the semantic query finds a result. This retains the document rather than deleting it, consistent with the entry's archival requirement.

data_operations.operation: Read and return memory status, including buffered content
data_operations.data_scope: Total record count, backend, complete buffered summary, and round count
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Status caller; no separate remote disclosure is established
data_operations.condition: Vector mode is available. Buffer content is returned when its file exists and parses successfully.

data_operations.operation: Scan active memories, calculate retention scores, archive low scores, and print previews
data_operations.source: All active Chroma documents and metadata
data_operations.data_scope: Complete active documents; created_at and access_count; archive status updates; first 20 characters of each newly archived document
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: maintenance.py memory, Chroma metadata, and maintenance stdout; daemon relays captured stdout to its own stdout
data_operations.condition: Maintenance runs successfully, manually or through the running daemon around 06:00 Beijing time. Scores below 0.15 are archived. No persistent stdout destination is specified.

data_operations.data_scope: Archived records whose last_accessed is more than 120 days old
data_operations.condition: Maintenance must first find at least one active record, otherwise it returns before cleanup. Eligibility uses time since last access, not time since archiving; missing last_accessed defaults to now. This does not delete the conversation log or summary buffer, and physical erasure is not established.

potential_excess.data_scope: Accumulated raw event content and timestamps retained without a packaged cleanup mechanism
potential_excess.condition: The hook continues receiving eligible events; no supplied component consumes or truncates this file.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Conversation recording is explicitly part of the temporary cache-to-summary pipeline; indefinite retention is not required.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep sufficient pending conversation to produce and safely persist the required memory summary.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Bound pending-cache retention and remove successfully processed entries. This narrows retention in a required caching action.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: First implement reliable consumption and acknowledge successful summary persistence; preserve unprocessed input and required context.

potential_excess.data_scope: Whole keyword-matching conversation segments, including unrelated material within a segment and possible repetition across categories
potential_excess.condition: summarize selects a segment containing a category keyword and remembering succeeds.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The method declares extraction of key information; verbatim retention is explicitly required for manual remembering, not for summaries.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain the relevant preference, decision, task, or learned fact with sufficient context.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Extract bounded relevant facts and deduplicate shared content across categories. This narrows data in the required summary write.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve negation, attribution, and context needed for accurate recall; retain manual remember's documented verbatim behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Recall queries stored as new conversation memories
potential_excess.condition: Only if an external integration supplies AUTO_LEARN=True; this branch is blocked by the undefined variable in the supplied package.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Recall requires searching and reinforcement. Documented automatic learning uses native flush, and packaged configuration declares auto_learn false.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Use the query for retrieval and reinforce selected memories.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove the additional query-storage action from recall, retaining separately authorized remembering and flush learning.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve semantic querying and access-metadata updates; resolve the undefined configuration binding before evaluating runtime behavior.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete buffered conversation summary in a routine status response
potential_excess.condition: Vector mode is available and a nonempty valid buffer exists.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry requests viewing memory status; content disclosure is an implementation choice beyond counts and operational state.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Report backend, record count, and pending-buffer state.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Return buffer rounds and a presence or size indicator; expose full summary content only through a separately requested inspection.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enough information to diagnose pending work. The existing response is a caller return, not evidence of external transmission.

potential_excess.data_scope: All active document bodies fetched for maintenance and 20-character previews printed for archived records
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: maintenance.py process memory; maintenance stdout and, when used, dream_daemon.py stdout
potential_excess.condition: Maintenance scans active records; a preview is printed when a record falls below the archive threshold.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Archival scoring and updates use identifiers and metadata, not document contents.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Fetch identifiers and scoring metadata, update status, and report maintenance results.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit documents from the required fetch and remove the redundant content-preview output; retain scores and aggregate counts.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve scoring, archival updates, cleanup, and useful operational diagnostics.

potential_excess.data_scope: Archived records already eligible for the implementation's 120-day inactivity deletion
potential_excess.condition: No active memories exist, causing maintenance to return before checking archived records.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The implementation includes deletion of long-inactive archives, but its early return can retain them indefinitely.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Apply the existing archive-cleanup eligibility rule independently of active-memory consolidation.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Run archived-record cleanup even when the active scan is empty.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep the archive-status and inactivity checks; preserve records that do not meet deletion eligibility.

unknowns: Automatic flush integration is unresolved: documentation specifies AI-triggered summarization, but supplied code contains no conversation-log reader, flush handler, or log cleanup. The hook only appends (hooks/fluid-memory-sync/HOOK.md:24-26; hooks/fluid-memory-sync/handler.js:47-77).

Recall and incremental persistence are blocked as packaged by undefined AUTO_LEARN and SUMMARY_THRESHOLD. CONFIG is loaded without binding either variable; config.yaml values cannot be assumed effective (fluid_skill.py:21-29,103-104,306-318; config.yaml:4-5).

Named OpenClaw tool registration and argument adaptation are absent. In particular, fluid_forget documents keyword while the CLI expects --content; the external mapping cannot be verified (SKILL.md:71-82; wrapper.py:55-65).

The actual author, direction, and extent of event.content are defined outside the package. The hook's 用户说 label does not establish that it records user messages or complete conversations (hooks/fluid-memory-sync/handler.js:47-61).

Chroma dependency source, version, embedding implementation, telemetry payloads, and recipients are unavailable. No explicit remote send appears in supplied code, but dependency-side disclosure and the documented no-cloud claim cannot be verified (fluid_skill.py:38-50,80-89,108-112; maintenance.py:31-38; README.md:150-159).

Collection deletion does not establish physical erasure, backup removal, or dependency retention behavior. Persistence of stdout by a hosting system is also undocumented (maintenance.py:111-114; dream_daemon.py:73-80).
